snippet.title: Cloudgazer: A Game About Watching Clouds - Launch Trailer [Steam, iOS, Android & Activity Book]
snippet.description:
Have you ever looked up at the sky and thought, "That's obviously a dinosaur"? Congratulations, you already know how to play.

Cloudgazer: A Game About Watching Clouds is a sky-gazing simulator where your only goal is to relax, watch the clouds, and discover the hundreds of hidden shapes drifting above you. No rush. No enemies. No explosions. Just you, the sky, and your imagination.

And yes, before you ask: we also recommend watching real clouds whenever you can. The graphics are amazing, and most of the time, they work pretty well.

But we know that's not always possible. Maybe there aren't any clouds where you live today. Maybe your window faces the building next door. Maybe you can't go outside. Or maybe you just feel like enjoying a perfect sky from the comfort of your couch.

That's exactly what Cloudgazer is for.

Steam Page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5052300/Cloudgazer_A_Game_About_Watching_Clouds/

App Store:
https://apps.apple.com/app/id6797771571/

Google Play:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.devilishgames.cloudgazer

Activity Book on Amazon: 
https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HFP4X5LN/
